name: Shortcode Example
description: Provides an example module illustrating how to implement your own shortcodes plugins.
keywords: how to write a shortcode plugin
project_description: Shortcode Example is a teaching submodule of the Shortcode framework. It ships a single reference plugin, BootstrapColumnShortcode (id 'col'), in src/Plugin/Shortcode/, demonstrating how to build a shortcode tag: a #[Shortcode] attribute, ShortcodeBase subclass, getAttributes() defaults, addClass() helper, process() and tips(). The [col] tag wraps content in a div with Bootstrap column-size classes (col-xs-*, col-sm-*, col-md-*, col-lg-*). Enable it alongside the base shortcode module to have a working example to copy when writing your own plugins. Requires the shortcode base module; core_version_requirement ^11.1 || ^12.
